title: Canonical Skill Frontmatter
description: Schema for the YAML frontmatter of a canonical skill at skills/<id>/SKILL.md. Restricted to the portable Agent Skills open-standard subset so the same file is valid, unmodified, for GitHub Copilot and Claude Code.

name.description: Human-readable display name. Free-form text; independent of the skill's directory name. The skill's `id` is always derived solely from its directory name (kebab-case), never from this field.

description.description: One-line purpose AND when to use (this is the sole carrier of 'applicability' in the generated catalog per FR-001/spec.md Key Entities). 'When not to use' detail remains in the skill body only and is intentionally not exposed in the catalog.

license.description: Optional license identifier for the skill content.

compatibility.description: Which of the 3 in-scope agents (FR-010) this skill targets. Defaults to 'all'.

deviation.description: The exact, isolated agent-specific deviation being declared (FR-002).
